शोधक (कः-का-कं)
a. Purifying.
m.
A refiner; the subtrahend.

शोधन (नं) 1.
n. Fæces; green vi-
triol; cleansing; correcting;
refining; subtraction; payment.
m. The lime.
f. (ई) A broom.
a. Cleansing, purifying.

शोधनीय (यः-या-यं)
a. To be correct-
ed or purified or paid.

शोधित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Cleaned, strain-
ed, refined; discharged.

शोध्य (ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
a. That should be
purified; payable.
m. One accu-
sed and to be tried.
n. A con-
stant number to be subtracted.
